title: Synthetic Tabular Data Generator
summary: A Streamlit application for generating synthetic tabular data from a CSV, offering a built-in Gaussian Copula method plus evaluation metrics and privacy filtering; it optionally imports SDV's Gaussian Copula, CTGAN, and TVAE synthesizers via sdv.single_table when the dependency is available, running them through a unified synthesizer_map interface.
evidence: synthesizers.py:225-227 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table and maps them by name
